name: La Cita
source:
You have a plan for today: Get a date with that [i]special someone[/i] who makes your heart go badabím-badabúm. Will you pull it off? And more importantly, who is it?

[Translated from [url=https://piopiojuegos.itch.io/la-cita]Itch.io[/url]]
